# Cookies Cakes website

This is a simple static website. Open `index.html` in a web browser to view it locally. All editable site files are in this folder; the original ZIP backups are in `../archive`.

## Before publishing

1. Add real cake photographs, replacing the clearly labelled photo placeholders on the Home, Cake Shed Weekly Menu, Custom Cakes and Portfolio pages.
2. Update the three social-media links (currently `#`) on each page.
3. Set up two Formspree forms, both delivering to the Cookies Cakes business email address:
   - a Cake Shed suggestion form; and
   - a Contact Us enquiry form.
4. In `menu.html`, replace `YOUR_SUGGESTION_FORM_ID` in the form address with the Cake Shed Formspree ID.
5. In `contact.html`, replace `YOUR_CONTACT_FORM_ID` in the form address with the Contact Us Formspree ID.
6. Test both forms once published. The Cake Shed form intentionally has no name or email field; the Contact Us form requires an email address so customers can receive a reply.

Formspree can add spam protection. If you prefer Cloudflare Turnstile, add it after the site is hosted through Cloudflare.
